description: The Chemical Guys easy reach wheel & rim detailing brush is the perfect tool for cleaning deep inside super-sensitive and delicate wheels. We get a lot of questions about wheel cleaning. Some of our customers have custom wheels that cost more than most people's cars, so they wonder what they'd need to keep them looking brand new. The extra-soft Gray brush is tough on dirt, grime, and brake dust, but extra gentle on painted, chrome, powder coated, and polished wheels. Cleaning wheels with old rags and stiff bristle brushes will only deliver subpar results and scratched finishes. The easy reach wheel & rim detailing brush features a slender profile densely-packed with soft Gray bristles. This is the perfect tool for scrubbing between spokes and deep inside the barrel of alloy wheels for a deep cleaning through and through. Easily bend and shape the flexible brush rod to scrub around brake calipers, the inner wheel rim, and behind wheel spokes. The long brush cleans All the way to the back of any wheel, and the soft rubber tip prevents scratching damage along the way. The brush also protects the user against scraped knuckles with the soft rubberized handle and cross guard. Use the easy reach wheel & rim detailing brush to clean deep inside wheels, exhaust tips, engine bays, and more. The soft bristles gently scrub and lift dirt and grime from wheels for a scratch-free shine. Easily clean away brake dust, dirt, oil, road grime, and more with the easy reach wheel & rim detailing brush. For best results, pair your easy reach wheel & rim detailing brush with your favorite Chemical Guys wheel cleaner and bucket of water with Chemical Guys car wash soap to clean wheels to a like-new condition. Choose the Chemical Guys easy reach wheel & rim detailing brush for deep wheel cleaning and detailing.
